content: असिः [अस्यते क्षिप्यते; अस्--इन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 139</ls>] .²1 A sword .²2 A knife used for killing animals. .²3 [अस्यति सेवनेन पापानि] <ab>N.</ab> of a river to the south of Benares. .²4 Breath ({@श्वास@}). .{@-सि@} {%ind.%} The 2nd <ab>pers.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> of the present of अस् to be, used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘त्वम्’ thou; as in कृतवानसि विप्रियं न मे <ls>Ku. 4. 7</ls> (where however असि may be taken as a verb).
